evidence: Inlines key and script storage logic directly into LegacyDataSPKM in src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.cpp to support legacy wallet migration.
rationale: This cleans up unnecessary abstractions by inlining legacy keystore functionality directly into LegacyDataSPKM after legacy wallet removal. As noted in the description, since legacy wallet is removed, 'there is no need to keep it around as a separate class' and containerizing legacy migration code provides solid maintenance value, but it is an internal refactor with no direct user-facing impact or bug fix.
